gloss: pedal misapplication; stepping on the wrong pedal

definitions.gloss: pressing the wrong pedal (accelerator instead of brake)
definitions.explanation: Stepping on the wrong pedal while driving—most often pressing the accelerator when meaning to brake. A frequent cause of accidents, often discussed in connection with elderly drivers. The noun form of {踏|ふ}み{間違|まちが}える.

examples.japanese: アクセルとブレーキの{踏|ふ}み{間違|まちが}え。
examples.english: Confusing the accelerator and the brake.

examples.japanese: {踏|ふ}み{間違|まちが}えによる{事故|じこ}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Accidents caused by pedal misapplication are increasing.

examples.japanese: {高齢者|こうれいしゃ}の{踏|ふ}み{間違|まちが}えを{防|ふせ}ぐ{装置|そうち}が{開発|かいはつ}された。
examples.english: A device to prevent pedal misapplication by elderly drivers has been developed.

notes:
The noun form of {踏|ふ}み{間違|まちが}える (to step on the wrong thing). In practice it almost always refers to pedal confusion when driving.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アクセルとブレーキの{踏|ふ}み{間違|まちが}え: confusing the accelerator and brake
- {踏|ふ}み{間違|まちが}え{事故|じこ}: an accident from pedal misapplication
- {踏|ふ}み{間違|まちが}えを{防|ふせ}ぐ: to prevent pedal misapplication
